title: Puglia's Diesel Prices Claw Back After a Sharp Late-July Slide
dek: Petrol keeps creeping up region-wide while diesel is four days into a rebound from its two-week low.
body: As of August 3, self-service drivers in Puglia paid €2.021 per liter for Benzina and €2.128 for Gasolio, both edging just above the national self-service averages of €2.011 and €2.124. The gap is narrow — about a cent on petrol, less than half a cent on diesel — but it's enough to put Puglia marginally above the rest of the country on both fuels for the moment.

The two fuels have taken very different paths to get there. Benzina has climbed on all seven of the last tracked days, up from €2.005 to €2.021, a slow but uninterrupted grind higher. Gasolio, by contrast, plunged from €2.198 to a low of €2.099 in just two days at the end of July, then reversed and has now risen for four straight days, clawing back roughly a third of that drop. Puglia's station network stayed essentially flat through it all: 1,576 registered stations with 1,434 reporting prices today, matching last week's count almost exactly — a sign of a stable, well-monitored local market even as prices moved.

Tracking a single region's prices down to the cent, day over day, only makes sense at this level of detail because nothing here is being typed into a spreadsheet by hand. Fuel Dashboard pulls the official MIMIT feed, recomputes every regional and national figure, and rotates through Italy's 20 regions automatically — rebuilding itself every single day. It's a small case study in what's now possible when Claude Code handles the plumbing: a daily publication that used to take an analyst an afternoon now just runs.
pull_quote: Diesel in Puglia has risen four days running, clawing back a third of its late-July plunge.
caption:
Today's regional spotlight on Fuel Dashboard: Puglia, where self-service diesel just closed out its fourth straight day of gains, recovering roughly a third of the sharp drop it took at the end of July. Petrol, meanwhile, has quietly climbed every single day this week — now sitting a touch above the national self-service average at €2.02/liter.

Fuel Dashboard tracks Benzina, Gasolio, GPL and Metano prices across all 20 Italian regions using the official MIMIT price feed, with a new region featured every day. Take a look: https://adeo-blip.github.io/fuel-price-italy/

What I like about this project isn't the data itself, it's how it's built. There's no analyst updating a spreadsheet every morning — Claude Code handles the entire pipeline: pulling the feed, recomputing regional and national averages, picking the day's featured region, and writing the article you're reading the caption of right now. It's a real example of AI tools turning what used to be a manual reporting chore into something that just runs itself, every day, without anyone touching Excel.
